request.style: English, epic orchestral, soaring male tenor vocal with mixed choir, full orchestra, brass, strings, choir, timpani, awe-filled and majestic, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the year that King Uzziah died
I saw the Lord seated on a high and lofty throne
And the train of his robe filled the temple
Above him stood seraphim, each with six wings

[Chorus]
Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts
The whole earth is full of his glory
Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts
The whole earth is full of his glory

[Verse]
The doorposts of the thresholds shook
And the house was filled with smoke
Woe to me! I am ruined
For I am a man of unclean lips
And my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts

[Verse]
Then one of the seraphim flew to me
Holding a glowing coal
He touched my mouth with it and said
See, this has touched your lips
Your guilt is taken away, and your sin is atoned for

[Bridge]
Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying
Whom shall I send? And who will go for us?
And I said, Here I am. Send me!
Here I am. Send me!

[Verse]
So he went out to a people who would hear but never understand
He spoke of a virgin's son, a sign from the Lord's own hand
Of a child who would be born to us, the Prince of Peace
He was pierced for our transgressions
And by his wounds we are healed

[Chorus]
Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts
The whole earth is full of his glory

[Outro]
Here I am. Send me!
